resale_co.name: Certificate of Compliance (COC), also called Certificate of Occupancy; Pre-Occupancy Inspection for sales
resale_co.issued_by: Zoning Office / Housing Office (Zoning & Housing Official)
requirements: House numbers 5 inches high and visible from the street
GFI protected outlets within 6 feet of a water source and on all exterior outlets
Fire extinguisher mounted in the kitchen
Appliances installed properly and working, no extension cords; exhaust fan over the stove (ductless hood allowed) and anti-tip bracket on the stove
Adequate electric, heating and plumbing service; two separate outlets in each habitable room
Bathroom vented or with a working window
Screened window in each room; all windows working with locks; exterior doors and hardware working
Handrails on steps with more than 3 risers; rails around landings or porches 30 inches or higher
Water heater relief valve piped to within 6 inches of the floor; emergency shut-off at the top of the stairs for a basement heater
Pools over 125 square feet and 3 feet or higher need a fence at least 4 feet high with a self-latching gate
House free of insect infestation
Smoke/CO inspection must pass (separate Bureau of Fire Prevention certificate)
Private well homes must comply with the Private Well Testing Act before sale; homes on a cesspool or privy cannot be sold until it is replaced with an approved system
resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill in the Upper Pittsgrove Township Pre-Occupancy Application, SALES Only (revised 03/30/2026) and mail it with a check payable to Upper Pittsgrove Township to the Township Housing Office, or bring it to the Municipal Building, 431 Route 77, Elmer. The Smoke/CO alarms inspection is a separate $25.00 application to the Bureau of Fire Prevention. Zoning Office hours are now Wednesday 10 a.m. to 12 p.m.

evidence.quote: UPT ordinance requires a COC (Certificate of Compliance) on residential or commercial rental properties whenever occupants change; therefore, a new COC is also required prior to the sale of a property.
Zoning Office Hours Wednesday 10 a.m.-12 p.m.

resale_co.notes: The Township Zoning and Construction page says a new Certificate of Compliance (also called a Certificate of Occupancy) is required before the sale of a property, and posts a Pre-Occupancy Application for sales (revised 03/30/2026): $25 inspection and $25 re-inspection if needed, check payable to Upper Pittsgrove Township, with the CO issued in the buyer's name. Changed since the last check: the Zoning & Housing Official listed on the page is now Andy Hoglen (was Tanya Timberman), and Zoning Office hours are now Wednesday 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. (were Tuesday 10 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.). The CO Inspection Checklist PDF still prints "Housing Official: Tanya Timberman". The email zoningofficer@upperpittsgrovenj.org is the one linked under Andy Hoglen (decoded from the page's Cloudflare email protection); Zoning Secretary Linda Stephens is linked to clerk@upperpittsgrovenj.org. The sales form says to mail it to "Upper Pittsgrove Township Housing Office 431 Route 40 Elmer, NJ 08313", while the Township office is at 431 Route 77, Elmer, NJ 08318; confirm the mailing address. No lead time or validity period is published. Building permits are handled by the Pittsgrove Township Construction Office (Chuck Hughes, Construction Officer). Rentals also need a COC on every change of occupant, a landlord registration and, for homes built before 1979, a lead-safe certificate; those are rental items, not resale items.

requirements: 10-year sealed battery alarms or hardwired alarms on every level of the dwelling; an alarm at the bottom of the basement stairwell at ceiling level
Alarms in the hallways within 10 feet of all bedrooms, and a smoke alarm in every bedroom

Smoke and CO alarms must be UL listed, less than 10 years old, working and installed per the maker's instructions; plug-in, battery or hardwired alarms are allowed, but hardwired alarms cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Do not plug alarms into switched outlets or outlets at the floor molding
A low-voltage fire alarm system must be tested and approved by an alarm contractor before the inspection; show the alarm certification to the inspector
House numbers at least 4 inches high, contrasting color, permanently fixed and visible from the street
Homes with solar, a generator or battery storage need a permanent printed label (wording like "Caution: Multiple Sources of Power") at the main electrical panel and the electric meter
The Township Housing CO checklist (separate from this form) still lists a fire extinguisher mounted in the kitchen

fire_cert.notes: Upper Pittsgrove enforces the fire code locally (LEA registry code M). The old April 2026 smoke/CO guidelines PDF (Smoke-and-CO-Application-Guidelines.pdf) now returns not found. The Zoning and Construction page now links a new Bureau of Fire Prevention form, "Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarms Inspection Application" (PDF created October 28, 2026, marked Revised 2026). The fee is unchanged at $25.00 with the same fee for a re-inspection after a failed or no-show inspection. What changed: payment is now due at the time of the inspection (the old form said it had to be received before the inspection), and exact cash is now accepted along with check or money order, payable to Upper Pittsgrove Township Bureau of Fire Prevention. The state fire directory (survey 5/18/2026) names Fire Official Timothy J O'Donnell at (856) 358-8500; the Township page lists him as Smoke/CO Alarms Inspector with the email upperpittsgrovefm@outlook.com. The new Bureau form does not list a fire extinguisher, matching the 2025 state change (P.L.2025, c.19), but the Township Housing CO checklist still lists a fire extinguisher mounted in the kitchen.

other_items.label: Private well testing
other_items.detail: Under the Private Well Testing Act (N.J.S.A. 58:12A-26), a home on a private well cannot be sold without complying with the Act.

other_items.label: Cesspool or privy
other_items.detail: N.J.A.C. 7:9A-3.16 bars the sale of a property served by a cesspool, privy, outhouse or pit toilet until it is replaced with an approved system.
